scope.runtime_mode: HAWKING_GLM_GPU_DEVICE_DSA=1, which requires resident state and HAWKING_GLM_GPU_COMPACT_MLA=1

required_projection_placements: q_a_proj is gravity-pq or device-native bf16
kv_a_proj_with_mqa is gravity-pq or device-native bf16
q_b_proj is gravity-pq or device-native bf16
on full-indexer layers, wq_b, wk, and weights_proj are gravity-pq or device-native bf16
admission.native_bf16_policy: The already default-off device DSA mode now admits rank-2 native.bf16 tensors directly on device, independently of the lm-head flag.
admission.host_native_fallback: If any dependent projection is host-native, the existing two-commit host normalization/RoPE scaffold remains active for correctness.
admission.reason: A host matvec cannot consume h or q_resid before the queued RMSNorm producing it has executed.

device_dispatches_full_indexer_layer: gravity_rmsnorm_f32: compressed latent prefix to k_latent
closed_attention_graph.dependency_end: The command buffer commits after o_proj; the following residual add is the first host consumer.
closed_attention_graph.diagnostic_readback: Only the final layer's DSA rank is read after the attention command buffer completes.

new_kernel.name: gravity_copy_head_prefix_f32
new_kernel.contract: Copy q[head*(qk_nope+qk_rope) + d] into compact_query_nope[head*qk_nope + d].
new_kernel.bounds: Input and output element ranges plus u32 ABI geometry are checked before dispatch.
new_kernel.test: Exact two-head extraction and undersized-output rejection in route_segment_mla_build_and_index_append_match_host_exactly.

normalization_and_rope.input_rmsnorm: device reduction over hidden_size using the artifact input-layer norm
normalization_and_rope.q_rmsnorm: device reduction over q_lora_rank using q_a_layernorm
normalization_and_rope.kv_rmsnorm: device reduction over the leading kv_lora_rank elements of the compressed projection
normalization_and_rope.key_rope: device RoPE reads the compressed projection at element offset kv_lora_rank
normalization_and_rope.query_rope: device RoPE reads each q head at qk_nope_head_dim with raw stride qk_dim
normalization_and_rope.numeric_contract: Complete-token Numeric Parity V2.1 plus exact greedy/top-5/DSA/expert decisions; parallel reduction order need not be bit-identical to the host scaffold.

lazy_state.allocation_trigger: first fully device-encodable compact attention prelude
lazy_state.reuse: Buffers are reused across layers and tokens after each prior layer command buffer completes.

synchronization_evidence.observed_rule: two attention-prelude and two full-indexer drains removed per full-indexer token
synchronization_evidence.qualification: Exact live wait counts on the bounded complete-token fixture plus source-derived flagship arithmetic; not sealed throughput evidence.

complete_token_numeric_parity_v2_1.fixture: deterministic one-layer, 16-vocabulary complete-token direct-u8 PQ fixture

default_resident_parity.command: env -u HAWKING_GLM_GPU_COMPACT_MLA -u HAWKING_GLM_GPU_DEVICE_DSA cargo test -p hawking-core --test gravity_glm_resident_parity -- --nocapture

default_gpu_forward.command: env -u HAWKING_GLM_GPU_COMPACT_MLA -u HAWKING_GLM_GPU_DEVICE_DSA cargo test -p hawking-core --test gravity_glm_gpu_forward -- --nocapture
